claims_and_rows.description_claim: The page description says Madagascar has 23 regions and 119 districts.

portal_observation.lawful_restoration: GET the exact canonical URL privately. The reproduction requires the captured 96,340-byte response and recorded SHA-256; a changed response is a new source vintage and must not be relabeled as this observation.

old_adm3_source.role_and_limit: 2018 administrative/statistical code listing at ADM3 commune level; it is not boundary geometry and predates the 2021 transfer.

source_comparison.role_and_limit: Retained ADM2 name crosswalk and district-polygon comparison; it is not a Namorona commune boundary comparison or proof that a polygon implements the transfer.

source_completeness_and_vintage.old_codps: 2018 ADM3 roster; complete retained file has 1,579 rows, but the row's source level is commune and its codes are historical.
source_completeness_and_vintage.codab: OCHA COD-AB v01; source metadata distinguishes boundary creation 2009-08-01 from valid_on 2018-08-10 and review on 2026-07-06. The valid_on field is a data-version date, not a legal effect date.
source_completeness_and_vintage.atlas_reference: geoBoundaries gbOpen district polygons dated 2020. A district comparison cannot locate or validate an ADM3 commune movement.
source_completeness_and_vintage.neighboring_granularity: The legal change is one commune (ADM3) between Mananjary and Manakara districts (ADM2). The retained measurements compare whole ADM2 polygons.

historical_claims.observed_defect: Both source-restoration vintages attribute the radio/television/posting effect clause to nonexistent Article 7 in each law. The later README says the portal gives older Vatovavy-Fitovinany context, but its source-restoration ledger and this captured portal identify Vatovavy and Fitovinany separately. The README's engineering handoff also omits the explicit Namorona exception when summarizing the 2021 district reorganization.

immutable_reference.inspection_status: This erratum preserves the already-recorded source interpretations below; it does not claim a new independent inspection of those source bodies.

antanimora_legal_and_operational_differe.decree_recorded_finding: Article 1 schedules Antanimora Sud under Ambovombe prefecture with eight named communes: Antanimora Sud, Ampamata, Andalatanosy, Imanombo, Jafaro, Marovato Befeno, Andragnanivo and Andoharano. Article 3 makes effect contingent on radio/television publication; the exact broadcast/publication date remains unknown.
antanimora_legal_and_operational_differe.operational_recorded_finding: The 2026 INSTAT operational notice names four communes (Ampamata, Imanombo, Jafaro and Andoharano). Its operational purpose does not repeal or redefine the decree roster; the four-versus-eight difference and polygon implications remain unresolved.
antanimora_legal_and_operational_differe.handoff: Do not use the operational notice to infer a legal repeal, complete commune list, district boundary, or effective date.

mapaction_secondary_lead.recorded_role: Secondary lead only. The retained source note says the mapbook lists BNGRC, GADM and OSM inputs and depicts Antanimora Atsimo as commune MG52516130 under Ambovombe-Androy.
mapaction_secondary_lead.limit: It does not establish legal continuity or polygon identity. The original BNGRC predecessor archive remains unrestored; the former 2018 OCHA/HDX resource returned 404 in the prior investigation. No predecessor geometry finding is made here.
